summary: Re-verified toast fix v3 and SAP price spec case-sensitivity fix. BOTH FIXES FULLY WORKING. Toast v3: confirmed via getComputedStyle on the <li data-sonner-toast> element itself (not just title text) - error toast bg=rgb(254,243,242)=#FEF3F2 with border=rgb(254,205,202)=#FECDCA and title_color=#B42318; add-success toast (visual, green banner confirmed); delete-success toast bg=rgb(236,253,243)=#ECFDF3 with border=rgb(171,239,198)=#ABEFC6 and title_color=#027A48. All three toast backgrounds now correctly self-tint (previously stayed white in v2). Price spec case-sensitivity fix: typed lowercase 'spc5wm' into Product ID input, clicked Load - input value became 'SPC5WM' after load (frontend .toUpperCase() confirmed working). sap-price-specs-table populated with NEXA TECHNOLOGIES (N1639) @ INR 0.18 Released, SANTOSHI ENTERPRISES (S2560) @ INR 0.17 Released (x2 rows), and M/s Prime Pack Not Released - matching expected SAP screen data exactly, no more 'No price specs found'. Regression check: ERP Prices panel, Purchase History from SAP, and Quota Arrangement (AI-generated) table all populated correctly for SPC5WM - AI quota table took ~40s to generate (consistent with iteration_55 baseline of 35-45s, not a regression).
critical_code_review_comments: sonner.jsx fix is correct: self-referential `data-[type=x]:!bg-[...]` on the 'toast' classNames key (matches the <li> itself which carries data-type) combined with `group-data-[type=x]:` correctly retained on title/description (genuine descendants of that <li>). No further issues found in this file.

sap_price_spec_client.py .strip().upper() normalization + QuotaAllocationPage.js searchProduct() .toUpperCase() correctly resolve the case-sensitivity gap; verified end-to-end in UI, not just backend curl.
